cases.description: Compare byte-read and array-buffer completion ordering without treating native promise creation as synchronous fulfillment.

files.main.cjs: const blob = require('./payload.cjs'); const order=['start']; const first=blob.bytes().then(bytes=>{order.push('bytes');return bytes;}); const second=blob.arrayBuffer().then(bytes=>{order.push('buffer');return bytes;}); order.push('sync'); Promise.all([first,second]).then(([bytes,buffer])=>{console.log(order.join(','));bytes[0]=0;console.log(new Uint8Array(buffer).join(','),blob.size);});

cases.description: A module reads input bytes, snapshots a Blob, awaits its native byte array and writes an independently checked file.

files.writer.cjs: const fs = require('node:fs'); const { Blob } = require('node:buffer'); module.exports = async function () { const input = fs.readFileSync('input.txt'); const blob = new Blob([input]); input.fill(0); const bytes = await blob.bytes(); fs.writeFileSync('result.txt', bytes); bytes.fill(0); return blob.size; };

cases.description: A module combines independent readable replies and a file-backed writable, awaiting actual finish before checking output.

files.main.cjs: const pair = require('./endpoint.cjs')(); (async function () { const replies=[]; const finish=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>pair.once('finish',resolve).once('error',reject)); const read=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>pair.once('end',resolve).once('error',reject)); pair.on('data',value=>replies.push(value)); pair.write('first\n'); pair.end('second\n'); await Promise.all([read,finish]); console.log('DUPLEX_PAIR',replies.join(',')); })();
files.endpoint.cjs: const stream = require('node:stream'); const fs = require('node:fs'); module.exports = function () { return stream.Duplex.from({readable:stream.Readable.from(['reply-a','reply-b']),writable:fs.createWriteStream('result.txt')}); };

cases.description: An ESM-provided promise becomes a readable Duplex; destroying a pending source closes it without publishing a later value.

files.main.mjs: import { Duplex } from 'node:stream'; import { value, pending, publish } from './source.mjs'; (async function () { const values=[]; for await (const item of Duplex.from(value)) values.push(item); const abandoned=Duplex.from(pending); abandoned.on('error',()=>{}); const closed=new Promise(resolve=>abandoned.once('close',resolve)); abandoned.destroy(); await closed; publish(); await Promise.resolve(); console.log('DUPLEX_PROMISE', values.join(','), abandoned.readableLength); })();
files.source.mjs: export const value=Promise.resolve(42); let resolve; export const pending=new Promise(done=>{resolve=done;}); export function publish(){resolve('late');}

cases.description: A CommonJS package awaits per-entry filters while recursively copying a project template, excluding an entire private subtree.

files.node_modules/fixture-template-copy/index: const { cp } = require('node:fs/promises'); module.exports = async function (source, destination) { await cp(source,destination,{recursive:true,filter:async function(path){await Promise.resolve();return !path.endsWith('/private');}}); };

cases.description: A helper preserves an existing destination with force false, reports errorOnExist and self-copy refusal, then explicitly overwrites the leaf.
An awaited filter changes source bytes before acceptance and a later falsy filter rejection prevents another destination from being created.

files.copy.cjs: const fs=require('fs'); const {cp}=require('fs/promises'); module.exports=async function(){await cp('source.txt','accepted.txt',{filter:async function(){await Promise.resolve();fs.writeFileSync('source.txt','after filter\n');return true;}});try{await cp('source.txt','rejected.txt',{filter:async function(){await Promise.resolve();throw false;}});throw Error('filter rejection lost');}catch(error){if(error!==false)throw error;console.log('FILTER_REJECTED',error);}};

cases.description: A package walks workspace directories asynchronously, reads discovered package manifests and writes an independently checked index.

files.node_modules/fixture-directory-index/ind: const {opendir}=require('node:fs/promises');const fs=require('fs');module.exports=async function(root){const dir=await opendir(root,{recursive:true});const rows=[];for await(const entry of dir){if(entry.isFile()&&entry.name==='package.json'){const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(entry.parentPath+'/'+entry.name,'utf8'));rows.push(p.name+':'+p.version);}}return rows.sort();};

cases.description: An ESM directory consumer stops early and verifies that iterator cleanup has closed the shared Dir cursor.

files.scan.mjs: import {opendir} from 'node:fs/promises';export async function first(root){const dir=await opendir(root,{recursive:true});let count=0;for await(const entry of dir){count++;break;}let code;try{await dir.read();}catch(error){code=error.code;}return [count,code];}
